build.beforeBuildCommand: cd araskova-doccraft && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build:desktop

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' blob: data: ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Every PDF tool. None of the uploads.
bundle.longDescription: OCULUS by Araskova: a local-first PDF toolkit with Malayalam OCR. Files are processed on this machine and never uploaded.
